title: NIST WebBook: Nitric acid is HNO3, molecular weight 63.0128 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Nitric acid as HNO3, molecular weight 63.0128 amu, CAS 7697-37-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Nitric acid, CAS Registry Number 7697-37-2, lists molecular formula HNO3 and molecular weight 63.0128 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 62.9956428955 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/HNO3/c2-1(3)4/h(H,2,3,4). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
